scope: Exact 76-entry source and executed-evidence reconciliation for the final four-file Layer Presets dockable candidate. This worker only reads evidence and edits addenda; it does not rerun builds/tests/verifiers or publish. Acceptance is bounded to native construction/help/optional-preview/context/no-implicit-Apply/lifecycle behavior; real row-click double application remains open.
public_base_qualification: Parent supplied publication identity; pinned Git source and tree resolved locally. No fresh remote publication query. Worktree HEAD is not treated as the public base.
candidate_snapshot_qualification: Final four-file candidate matches stable source seal and both native-v3/ASan-v1 recorded source identities. No publication commit is claimed by this addendum. Any later source edit invalidates this acceptance binding.

source_finding.legacy_action_help: gimp-layer-preset-dialog at :231; only occurrence in pinned app/menus search, no manual-page existence proof
source_finding.candidate_factory_and_action_help: GIMP_HELP_DOCK, existing gimp-dock identifier at app/widgets/gimphelp-ids.h:734
source_finding.mechanism: Native dialog factory constructs child then wraps it with gimp_dockable_new; that API rejects NULL help before constructing wrapper. Inner-view or registration-presence tests do not execute this boundary.
source_finding.semantic_delta: Executed bounded restoration of native non-NULL help construction and optional tab-preview icon fallback, retaining inherited GimpDocked methods. Final tests accept context/no-implicit-Apply/close/reopen behavior. Original exported functions, exact old help metadata, full preview parity and real row-click Apply correctness remain separate.

preview_adaptation.operation: Reimplement inherited GimpDocked interface narrowly with iface->get_preview = NULL; leave inherited context/menu/button-bar/aux-info methods untouched.
source_mechanism: GimpContainerEditor get_preview forwards to the inner view (gimpcontainereditor.c:484-493).
GimpContainerBox get_preview obtains context property name from the container child type and passes it to property preview construction (gimpcontainerbox.c:245-276).
GimpLayerPreset has no GimpContext resource-property mapping; gimp_context_type_to_prop_name returns NULL (gimpcontext.c:1860-1873).

gimp_docked_get_preview returns NULL for an absent optional method (gimpdocked.c:152-165). Native gimp_dockable_create_tab_widget falls back to registered icon for Preview/Preview+Name/Preview+Blurb (gimpdockable.c:291-303).
gimp_dockable_set_tab_style maps preview styles to icon styles when child get_preview is NULL (gimpdockable.c:393-407).
preview_adaptation.semantic_scope: Native compatibility adaptation for a resource selected by this view, not a new GimpContext property or selected-resource thumbnail renderer. Uses existing GIMP_ICON_LAYER and normal icon fallback; no exact old preview/rendering parity claim.
preview_adaptation.lifecycle_scope: Existing GimpDataFactoryView auxiliary-info and inherited context/menu/button-bar handlers remain registered; runtime correctness is not inferred solely from interface source.

legacy_inactive_paths: app/widgets/gimpitemtreeview.c:424-433 new-button preset dropdown and :460-466 duplicate-button preset dropdown are both under #else of literal #if 1; not active workflows and not enabled by this fix.

assertions_present: Independent actual factory raise versus dialogs-layer-presets image UI action; action route only observes find_widget and has no creating fallback.
Opening precedes help metadata assertions, exposing production NULL-help guard rather than a proxy assertion.
Native wrapper/child mapped, registered factory identity, real notebook page/dockbook/dock ownership, matching help IDs.
Real image/display exists before first open; verifies inherited child context image/display without rescuing it after construction.
Wrapper-derived menu path/popup owner and cached action manager/group identity.
Two close/reopen cycles; repeat raise reuses exact wrapper and child with one registered open dialog.
No implicit source mutation checks include source identity/count/selection, pixels, name, dimensions, offsets, opacity, mode, dirty state and Undo/Redo depths before/after loop drains.
Selection and real Apply action produce one extra layer/Undo step; Undo restores source; context detach/reattach remains nonmutating.
Normal Close Tab command; weak wrapper/view/manager/group clearing, cache-key removal and absent factory widget/open registration.
Restore original display/image/path and drain autosave while owners remain alive.

Preview-specific source assertions: no GimpContext property for LayerPreset and NULL optional get_preview; registered GIMP_ICON_LAYER; construct/destroy all three Preview, Preview+Name and Preview+Blurb tab styles; assert Preview+Name normalizes to Icon+Name.
Natural bounded weak-pointer mapping wait preserves destruction/unmapped failures and does not force GTK state; final full aggregate executes both factory and action cases together.
source_design_limits: New native-wrapper helper does not activate Refresh via the wrapper-derived menu; older synthetic-view selection-actions-lifetime exercises Refresh separately. Do not claim wrapper Refresh coverage from the new cases.

After selection/Apply the new helper checks two layers and one Undo step, but does not explicitly assert new layer is GimpCloneLayer or that its source equals the original. Do not claim those identity assertions are present.
Helper checks zero Undo/expected Redo depth and original source pixels/identity, but not Undo/Redo top-record identity. Depth preservation alone is not top-record preservation.
Actual row-click double application is an observed open defect; programmatic selection plus explicit action assertions do not prove whole physical-input Apply correctness.
candidate_test_source.runtime_status: PASSED in final native-v3 and ASan-v1 strict 36-case selections: both new cases are included in UI6, alongside backend11 and editor19.
candidate_test_source.fixture_status: Resolved: final wait_native_mapped uses a weak pointer, two-second monotonic bound, nonblocking context iterations and 1ms sleep; it neither retains widget nor forces visibility/mapping. Original mapped assertions and post-event source/history checks remain. Both final aggregates pass.

preserved_open_items: Layer Presets real row-click double application remains open: one native press/release added two clones, whereas explicit Apply button added one. No general Apply correctness or whole-row closure.
Separate 31 core-extension hooks are neither merged into nor completed by this 76-entry addendum.
MyPaint legacy overwrite remains open, independent of already published name/preset/copy restorations.
MyPaint configurable foreground/background colorpicker setter and exact API disposition remain open.
Blocked eleven-file perspective guard and valid-index/wrong-point identity gap remain open; no integration allowed by this report.
Original exported C symbols/named-handle contracts are not considered fulfilled merely because a native workflow is restored.
08.018 and overall migration completion are unchanged; no whole-row or aggregate acceptance.
